name: Tension-Type Headache
definition: Primary headache disorder typically causing bilateral pressing or tightening pain of mild-to-moderate intensity without prominent neurological symptoms.

typical: Not usually worsened by routine activity
Minimal nausea; photo/phonophobia may be absent or mild

redFlags.item: New headache after trauma or in cancer/immunosuppression

investigations.MRI: Imaging only for atypical features or red flags.

green: Education, sleep/activity regularity and stress management
amber: Avoid frequent analgesic use that may cause medication-overuse headache.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Shirah-shoola phenotype may be documented without assuming one-to-one equivalence.

patientEducation.summary: Primary headache disorder typically causing bilateral pressing or tightening pain of mild-to-moderate intensity without prominent neurological symptoms.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
